title: FORTALEZA = STRENGTH | Dreamfarmcommons
plain_text:
Saturday, October 12, 2019
7:30 PM – 9:30 PMFORTALEZA = STRENGTH
Free Outdoor Film Night on Indigenous Resistance DayAn outdoor evening of films celebrating roots, cultures, contributions & defiance of indigenous communities on Indigenous Resistance
​
Dream Farm Commons, ProArts and Xiquihuitl Media invite you to an evening of FREE outdoor video celebrating the roots, cultures, contributions and defiance of our indigenous communities. Featuring documentaries and narratives made by Native People from across the Americas, these videos show us how strength and resistance shape our histories, present, and future. De-colonizing our imagination one video frame at a time, we invite you to reimagine future possibility and to briefly reclaim the city streets as we project onto the graffitied walls of 15th and Webster Streets, into the evening.
